title: Leveraging SG Arts Plan to Emphasise Importance of Arts Education
what_it_is: Leveraging SG Arts Plan to Emphasise Importance of Arts Education

sections.label: Arts education in Singapore schools
sections.summary: NAC's Our SG Arts Plan supports arts education through programmes like the Artist-in-School Scheme and NAC-AEP, with museum-based learning added in 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Speaker, strengthening arts education is an important component of the National Arts Council’s (NAC's) Our SG Arts Plan launched in October 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Not only does early exposure to the arts nurture creative thinking and help our children develop empathy and confidence, it also paves the way for arts appreciation and participation to be a way of life for them as they grow up.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Therefore, strong arts education programmes will produce many future arts supporters and audiences, patrons, collectors, art ambassadors and leaders of arts and cultural organisations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Some examples include initiatives like the NAC’s Artist-in-School Scheme, where arts professionals work with schools, including preschools, on specialised workshops or courses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Ninety-eight percent of the Ministry of Education (MOE) schools participate in NAC’s Arts Education Programme (NAC-AEP) which aims to build broad appreciation of the arts and deepen knowledge.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: In 2016, over 3,000 NAC-AEP programmes were taken up by schools.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: In 2018, museum-based learning was incorporated as one of the core learning experiences for Primary 4 students in MOE's primary arts syllabus.

sections.label: NAC's five arts education efforts
sections.summary: NAC will support arts educators, grow research, increase access, deepen school engagement, and support early childhood arts education.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: As part of Our SG Arts Plan, NAC will build on existing efforts to, first, further support arts educators and instructors to improve the quality of arts education; second, grow research to explore the impact of early exposure to the arts to improve programmes; third, continue to increase access to the arts; fourth, deepen its engagement with schools and nurture distinctive schools in the arts; and fifth, support early childhood arts education.
